meta.name: Little Big Lab
meta.eyebrow: A SMALL SPACE FOR BIG CURIOSITY
meta.kicker: Make a little. Learn a lot.
meta.intro: A home for things being figured out: quick experiments, curious side quests, useful projects and the occasional finished thing.

projects.title: Tiny Weather Station
projects.summary: A pocket-sized display that turns weather numbers into a friendly forecast.
projects.description: A small electronics and interface project exploring how a few sensors and a simple display can make weather easier to understand.
projects.note: The first version only needs to show temperature and a simple weather icon. Extra features can wait.

projects.title: Pixel Garden
projects.summary: A tiny digital garden where each click grows a new pixel plant.
projects.description: A playful browser experiment about patterns, colour and tiny bits of generative art.
projects.note: A POC is allowed to be a little weird. Try a few growth rules and keep the one that feels fun.

projects.title: The Story Machine
projects.summary: Mix a character, a place and a surprise to invent a new story prompt.
projects.description: A quick prototype that combines three random ingredients to help kick-start imaginative stories.
projects.note: This is a disposable prototype. It can be rebuilt from scratch whenever a better idea appears.

projects.title: Club Noticeboard
projects.summary: A simple board for sharing club plans, reminders and useful links.
projects.description: A small web app concept for organising a group activity. The public sample contains invented events and names only.
projects.note: Before using a real group, review privacy and get permission. This demo uses fictional information.

projects.title: Sound Shapes
projects.summary: An idea for turning simple sounds into colourful moving shapes.
projects.description: A concept saved for later. It is not currently being developed, and that is perfectly fine.
projects.note: Some ideas can wait on the shelf until they become interesting again.

projects.title: Pocket Space Notes
projects.summary: A visual notebook for collecting discoveries about planets and stars.
projects.description: A learning project that organises space facts into short, illustrated cards.
projects.note: Keep sources attached to facts and make it easy to correct a card when something new is learned.

updates.title: A project can pause without failing
updates.text: Sound Shapes is on the shelf for now. Parking an idea keeps the door open without making it another chore.

updates.title: The first version can be tiny
updates.text: The weather station started with one number on one screen. That was enough to make the next step obvious.

updates.title: Try the strange version
updates.text: Pixel Garden got more interesting when the plants were allowed to grow in unexpected patterns.
